title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the research-notebook direction. Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Cuaderno de campo
options.thesis: The group's site as the ruled working notebook where analyses, seminar notes and people are logged as dated entries.
options.viewport: A squared-paper spread: red margin rail with entry numbers, the BIO³ cube stamped as the entry seal, and the group statement written as the day's first entry.
options.risk: Reads cute or crafty if the ruling is heavy and the paper warms too far.

raised.raise: Seminars as time-ranked rows with explicit states (announced / upcoming / past), columns fixed, only the state changes.
One orchestrated motion clock: a single reveal rhythm for the whole site instead of scattered hover effects.
Metadata as corner-anchored readouts: roles, dates and departments pinned to card edges as compact OSD-style labels.
A vertical margin rail doubles as a section depth-gauge, marking where you are in the notebook as you scroll.
Lifecycle stage bands: every seminar carries a visible stage label (convocatoria → próxima → celebrado) in the grid.

regions.label: hero entry: cube stamp + BIO³ statement

options.label: Offprint
options.thesis: The group presented as a publishable article: masthead, structured abstract, numbered sections, figure plates and reference rules.
options.viewport: A journal masthead over the group name, an abstract block stating what BIO³ is, then numbered sections with a figure plate of the group's disciplines.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on; familiar and safe by design.

options.label: Departures Board
options.thesis: The seminar cycle as a departure board: sessions ranked by date, states flipping as the term runs.
options.viewport: Ruled rows of sessions with date, speaker and state columns, cascading per-character flips on update.
options.risk: Reads transit-novelty on a research group's homepage.
options.case: Fuses for seminar dates, but members and bios do not fit fixed flap cells; loses both axes.
options.kept: Live time-ranked rows with explicit states.

options.label: Source Floor
options.thesis: The group's methods as live code on a phosphor terminal, everything reacting on one clock.
options.viewport: A monospaced source buffer at stage scale, each block a discipline the group works in.
options.case: The code-buffer grammar carries methods but not people or seminars; loses both axes.
options.kept: One shared clock orchestrating every motion on the site.

options.label: Viewfinder HUD
options.thesis: The site as a camera frame: corner brackets frame each block, readouts report state.
options.viewport: A full-bleed frame with metadata pinned in the safe-area corners and brackets tightening on focus.
options.risk: Gimmick-heavy when every element wears an OSD.
options.case: Strong edge metadata, but the empty centre fights dense academic text; loses on clarity.

options.label: Editorial Program
options.thesis: The group as an editorial program: serif masthead, strict two-column grid, one spot colour per section, the cube mark hidden once per view.
options.viewport: A serif masthead over a two-column grid opening with an oversized initial, the BIO³ cube tucked into the composition.
options.risk: Editorial polish can drift into generic magazine-land.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the grid carries long bios beautifully; does not beat the notebook on audience identification — peers publish in this register rather than live in it.

options.label: Deep Dive
options.thesis: Reading the site as a descent: surface, thermocline, reef ledge, each depth a section.
options.viewport: A vertical depth axis with the group's name at the surface and the seminar cycle at depth.
options.risk: Metaphor-first: dark ground and dive framing obscure an institutional subject.
options.case: Beautiful vertical pacing but peers do not identify with dive tourism; loses both axes.
options.kept: A vertical margin rail used as a depth-gauge for scroll position.

options.label: Stage Calendar
options.thesis: Everything on the site carries a visible maturation stage, like jars labelled by day.
options.viewport: Shelf lines of labelled entries, each with stage, date and condition.
options.case: Stage labelling transfers well, but the food-theatre material fights the audience; loses both axes.
options.kept: Explicit lifecycle stage bands on seminar entries.

options.label: The category standard
options.thesis: What every university research group ships: navy hero with photo, three cards, logo strip — executed impeccably.
options.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from every other group page by design.
